    def evaluate_window(train_end_year):
    train_data = df["CPI"][:f"{train_end_year}-12"]
    test_data = df["CPI"][f"{train_end_year+1}-01":f"{train_end_year+1}-12"]
    if len(test_data) < 12:
    return None
    # SARIMA forecast
    model = SARIMAX(train_data, order=(0,1,2), seasonal_order=(2,0,1,12), trend='n')
    fit = model.fit(disp=False)
    pred = fit.get_forecast(steps=12).predicted_mean
    sarima_mape = np.mean(np.abs((test_data.values - pred.values) / test_data.values)) * 100
    # Naive forecast (same month last year)
    naive_pred = train_data[-12:].values
    naive_mape = np.mean(np.abs((test_data.values - naive_pred) / test_data.values)) * 100
    return sarima_mape, naive_mape

    results = []

    r = evaluate_window(year)
    if r:
    results.append({"Test Year": year+1, "SARIMA MAPE": r[0], "Naive MAPE": r[1]})

    results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
    print(results_df)
    print("\nAverage SARIMA MAPE:", results_df["SARIMA MAPE"].mean())
    print("Average Naive MAPE:", results_df["Naive MAPE"].mean())
